title: The localization of a ring at the points specializing to a locally closed subscheme of the form D(f) cap V(I)
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a locally closed subscheme Z of the spectrum of A of the form D(f) cap V(I) there is a multiplicative subset S such that the spectrum of S^{-1}A is homeomorphic to the set of points specializing to Z, that this algebra depends only on the underlying subset, that Z is a closed subscheme of it, and that ring maps with a compatible Z' induce a unique map of these localizations (statement lines 709-726). The proof (proof lines 728-748) identifies S through the sections on Z, characterizes the surviving primes by an explicit divisibility argument, and derives the remaining statements formally. H2: one explicit argument with two inputs, written out in full.
